title: Risk Register Update: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Add the threat of an unspecified seal on the pump, and revisit the rating of the leak test after maintenance.

items.text: Proposals for the risk owner to assess: no loss estimates and no rating decisions.

items.risk: Loss of containment at the pump
items.evidence_says: Seals were bought locally without a specification [EVD-0003].
items.proposed_change: Add an unspecified seal as a threat to this risk.

items.risk: Loss of containment at the pump
items.current_assumption: A leak test is done before every restart.
items.evidence_says: The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002].
items.proposed_change: Reassess the rating of the leak-test control against its records.

items.name: Restarts with a leak-test record
items.measure: Share of pump restarts with a signed test record

items.barrier: maintenance and testing: leak test before return to service
items.fix: Interlock the restart on a signed test record
